{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/penguins.csv'
penguins = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for missing values in body_mass_g
missing_body_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()

# Compute the mean body mass, ignoring missing values
mean_body_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].mean()

missing_body_mass, mean_body_mass"}
